messages.subject: Add new points to grid

Hello All,

I am trying to create a grid where points can be added anywhere on the grid by clicking. In addition, I would like a popup to appear after a point has been created in order to add attribute values to the point. Can any of you point me in the right direction?

Thank you!

- Josiah

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Add new points to grid
parts:
Start here:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/plot-interaction.html

You'll probably want to keep track of your data as a data frame in a reactiveValues object, and use observeEvent(input$click, { ... }) to add rows to the data frame.
